name: system-proxy-codex
description: Enable Codex system-proxy support automatically and configure proxy environment variables safely with Python.

interface.shortDescription: Make Codex use your local system proxy without hand-editing config files.
interface.longDescription: Automatically enables Codex's respect_system_proxy feature on first start. An optional Python setup command detects Windows, macOS, or Linux proxy settings and safely merges HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, and NO_PROXY into CODEX_HOME/.env with backups.
defaultPrompt: 使用 system-proxy-setup 一键配置 Codex 代理。
使用 system-proxy-setup，把 Codex 代理端口设置为 7890。
检查当前 Codex 系统代理配置。
